verdict.rationale: AvaTax claims tax rates and rules for 200+ countries and offers VAT reporting and Cross-Border duty and landed-cost calculation, so international VAT calculation is broadly within scope. Nothing in the pack shows B2B-specific handling. Missing for 10: real-time VAT/tax ID validation against official registries (e.g. VIES), documented reverse-charge determination for B2B transactions, any hands-on or independent corroboration of B2B cross-border correctness.
